test_cases.name: Batch (20 entries) Systemic Theme Detection
test_cases.input: 20 student feedback entries from sample_feedback.csv (IDs FB-001 to FB-020)
test_cases.expected: 20 classifications, >= 2 themes, detects workload/assessment clustering, non-zero verifiable counts, actionable recommendations
test_cases.actual: Classified=20, Themes=4 (['Excessive Workload and Assignment Clustering', 'Exceptional Lab and Teaching Assistance', 'Delayed Grades and Unclear Rubrics']), Suggestions=4

top_themes.description: Students report overwhelming stress and burnout caused by heavy workloads, including multiple high-stakes assignments and lab reports due during midterm and finals weeks. The timing of these tasks leaves no time for deep learning or rest.

Students express strong appreciation for teaching assistants and faculty who break down complex technical concepts, provide engaging real-world examples, and go above and beyond to support debugging and learning.
Feedback highlights major frustrations with slow grading turnarounds, missing score releases prior to major exams, and the absence of clear rubrics or explanatory comments on assignments.
